name: malda-language
description: Language support for MALDA (.malda) via the MALDA Language Server, plus interpret-mode debug (F5) via malda debug-adapter.

program.description: Path to the .malda program to interpret. Use ${file} for the active editor.

args.description: Stored launch arguments (not a language-level argv in v1).

stopOnEntry.description: Pause on the first stoppable statement.

env.description: Optional environment variables for the debuggee process.

configurationSnippets.label: MALDA: Debug file
configurationSnippets.description: Launch the current .malda file in the interpret-mode debugger.

maldaLanguageServer.path.description: Path to the MALDA language server executable (malda-lsp or malda-lsp.exe). Use full path if not on PATH. Separate from malda.cli.path (debug adapter).

maldaLanguageServer.trace.description: Traces the communication between the editor and the language server.

malda.types.strict.description: When true (default), type-hint mismatches and unknown hints are reported as Errors. When false, mismatches are Warnings and unknown hints are Information (lenient). Does not enable CLI --strict-types extras (match exhaustiveness, @pure, bounds).

malda.cli.path.description: Path to the MALDA CLI used for interpret-mode debug (`malda debug-adapter`). Default is `malda` on PATH. Use a full path to a built CLI if needed (for example artifacts/malda-cli/malda or malda.exe). Separate from maldaLanguageServer.path (LSP).
